decisions.reason: As a close-to-core software product aligned with the firm's connected, data-driven strategy, it is likely to meet aspiration or be supported by organizational slack while sold within integrated projects.
This safety hardware is more peripheral to the firm's digital trajectory, but it still complements infrastructure projects and can be retained if it satisfies a modest niche aspiration.

Control technology for water engineering machinery is central to the firm's core systems business, so management would usually tolerate uncertain standalone results and keep it unless performance clearly falls below aspiration.

Its strong fit with flow automation, system software, and the firm's move toward secure data-driven operation makes continued retention more likely, despite some uncertainty because it is the newest product.
